name: Warje
civicNote: Under PMC; the area falls in PMC's Warje-Karvenagar ward office jurisdiction.
summary: A residential area in south-west Pune at the end of Karve Road, beyond Kothrud, on the Mutha river where the Mumbai-Bengaluru bypass crosses it.
knownFor: Western end of Karve Road, beyond Kothrud and Karve Nagar
Mumbai-Bengaluru bypass crossing over the Mutha river
connectivity: Mumbai-Bengaluru highway bypass runs through Warje
Karve Road connects Warje to Kothrud and Deccan
suits: Households wanting a residential area next to Kothrud with direct access to the Mumbai-Bengaluru highway.
